fullDescription: A clean light-SaaS marketing page anchored on one confirmation dialog rendered live over a dimmed, blurred page: a white rounded-2xl modal with an emerald top accent bar, a soft-ringed emerald check icon, a question title plus plain-language body, a quiet Cancel and a filled primary action (stacked primary-on-top on mobile), and a lock reassurance line, with the same skeleton reshown as emerald-confirm, amber-warning and rose-danger variants.
prompt:
## Resumo
A frameless, full-bleed marketing page for an AI design-agent prompt-library ('ModalDesign'), anchored on one confirmation dialog rendered live over a dimmed, blurred faux app page. The page stacks top to bottom: a sticky translucent nav, a dot-grid hero with a giant balanced headline (the phrase 'don't make people flinch' set in emerald with a hand-drawn underline squiggle) and two CTAs, the showcase section where a centered white dialog (top emerald accent bar, a soft-ringed emerald check icon, a question title + plain-language body, a Cancel/primary action pair, and a tiny lock reassurance line) floats above six faux dashboard cards behind a 62% scrim, a white 'Anatomy' section of five numbered feature tiles plus an emerald 'restyle in one prompt' CTA tile, a near-black 'Variants' band showing the same dialog skeleton in three intents (emerald confirm, amber warning, rose danger), an emerald-accented dot-grid library CTA card, and a footer. The aesthetic is clean light-SaaS: white surfaces, a slate 'ink' neutral ramp, a single emerald accent, Inter throughout, generous rounded-2xl corners, and soft layered shadows, with one deep 'dialog' drop-shadow reserved for the modal itself.

## Estilo Visual
Use a clean light-SaaS design system. Page background white #ffffff; primary text 'ink-900' #0f172a; muted text 'ink-500' #64748b. Define a slate-tinted neutral 'ink' ramp (50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a, 950 #020617) and a single emerald accent ramp (50 #ecfdf5, 100 #d1fae5, 200 #a7f3d0, 300 #6ee7b7, 400 #34d399, 500 #10b981, 600 #059669, 700 #047857, 800 #065f46, 900 #064e3b); the primary action is emerald-600 #059669, hover emerald-700 #047857. Use Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900) for everything with -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased. Headlines are font-extrabold, tracking-tight, leading ~1.05, scaling text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> lg:text-6xl, and use text-wrap: balance; body copy is text-lg leading-relaxed in ink-500; eyebrows are text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider. Corners: rounded-lg on small buttons/chips, rounded-xl on large buttons, rounded-2xl on cards and the dialog, rounded-3xl on the big library CTA card, rounded-full on pills. Depth is soft and layered via two custom box-shadows: .shadow-soft = 0 1px 2px rgba(2,6,23,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(2,6,23,0.12) (used on nav button, chips, cards, anatomy tiles); .shadow-dialog = 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(2,6,23,0.45), 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(2,6,23,0.30) (reserved for the floating modal and card hover). Add two background textures: .dotgrid = radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,23,42,0.06) 1px, transparent 0) sized 22px 22px (hero + library CTA); .backdrop-dim = radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, rgba(16,185,129,0.10), transparent 55%) over rgba(2,6,23,0.62) with backdrop-filter: blur(3px) (the modal scrim). Add .ring-emerald-soft = box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.18) for the dialog status icon. Ration emerald to accents only (logo glyph, hero underline squiggle, eyebrow pills, dialog accent bar + check icon + primary buttons, anatomy tile hover borders, library CTA); keep the broad surfaces white and the neutrals slate. html { scroll-behavior: smooth }.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent nav
A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/70">` with an inner `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 lg:px-8`. Left: a logo lockup = a 36x36 (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl bg-ink-900 tile with shadow-soft holding an emerald-400 ph:squares-four-bold icon (width 20), next to a wordmark 'Modal' (text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tight) where 'Design' is text-emerald-600. Center (hidden md:flex, gap-9): four nav links 'Showcase / Anatomy / Variants / Library' in text-sm font-medium text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900. Right (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Sign in' text link (hidden sm:block, text-sm font-medium text-ink-600) and a primary CTA = inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700, reading 'Open in canvas' + a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon (width 14).

### Dot-grid hero
A `relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white dotgrid` section with a thin top accent line (a pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-emerald-400/60 to-transparent). Inner: `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-14 pt-16 lg:px-8 lg:pb-20 lg:pt-24`, content centered in a max-w-3xl. Top: an eyebrow pill = inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 with a ph:cards-bold icon (width 14), reading 'Prompt library . Overlays & dialogs'. Headline: an `h1` mt-6 text-balance font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink-900 scaling text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> lg:text-6xl, reading 'Confirmation dialogs that' then a relative text-emerald-600 (sm:whitespace-nowrap) span 'don't make people flinch' that has an absolute hand-drawn underline = an inline `<svg viewBox='0 0 300 12'>` path stroke #10b981 stroke-width 3 stroke-linecap round opacity 0.55 sitting -bottom-1.5 left-0 w-full. Subhead: a mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl text-balance text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-500 paragraph. CTA row (mt-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row): a primary ink button = inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-ink-800 with a ph:cursor-click-bold icon (width 16) 'See the live dialog'; and a secondary outline button = rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 shadow-soft hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50 'Read the anatomy'. Both are w-full on mobile, sm:w-auto.

### Showcase: dialog over a dimmed page
A `#showcase` section, relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-ink-50. Layer 1 (aria-hidden absolute inset-0 select-none): a faux app page = an inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-12 with a top bar (a flex justify-between row: an h-8 w-44 rounded-lg bg-ink-200/80 title placeholder, plus a flex gap-3 with an h-9 w-9 rounded-lg bg-ink-200/70 icon button and an h-9 w-24 rounded-lg bg-emerald-200/60 button), then a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of six h-44 rounded-2xl border border-ink-200/70 bg-white shadow-soft placeholder cards. Layer 2: the `.backdrop-dim` scrim = absolute inset-0 z-10. Layer 3 (relative z-20): a flex min-h-[640px] w-full items-center justify-center px-5 py-20 sm:py-24 holding the centered confirmation dialog (a relative w-full max-w-md; see special components 'Confirmation dialog').

### Anatomy section
An `#anatomy` section, border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white, inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24. Centered intro (mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an eyebrow 'Anatomy' (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600), an `h2` mt-3 text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'Five parts. No more, no less.', and a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-500 support line. Then a mt-14 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of five numbered feature tiles + one CTA tile. Each feature tile = group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-soft hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-dialog, with a top row of a 40x40 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 icon tile (Phosphor icons: ph:circle-half-tilt-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:squares-four-bold, ph:x-circle-bold) beside a tiny text-ink-400 number ('01'..'05'), then a mt-5 text-lg font-bold title and a mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-500 paragraph (titles: Dimmed backdrop / Status icon / Title & message / Action pair / Escape hatch). The sixth CTA tile = flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 to-white p-6 shadow-soft, with a 40x40 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white ph:magic-wand-bold tile, a 'Restyle in one prompt' title, a text-ink-600 paragraph, and a bottom emerald-700 'Browse the library ->' text link (ph:arrow-right-bold).

### Variants dark band
A `#variants` section, border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-950 (near-black #020617), inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24. Centered intro (mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an emerald-400 eyebrow 'Variants', an `h2` mt-3 text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'One pattern, every intent', and a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-400 support line. Then a mt-14 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of three mini-dialog cards, each = rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white p-6 shadow-dialog with a centered 48x48 rounded-xl tinted icon tile, a mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold title, a mt-1.5 centered text-sm text-ink-500 line, and a mt-5 flex gap-2.5 button pair (a quiet outline cancel + a filled accent action). Intent 1 = emerald: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 ph:check-circle-bold, 'Confirm' / 'Publish this design?' / Cancel + bg-emerald-600 'Publish'. Intent 2 = amber: bg-amber-50 text-amber-500 ph:warning-bold, 'Discard changes' / 'You have unsaved edits.' / 'Keep editing' + bg-amber-500 'Discard'. Intent 3 = rose: bg-rose-50 text-rose-500 ph:trash-bold, 'Delete project' / 'This can't be undone.' / Cancel + bg-rose-600 'Delete'.

### Library CTA + footer
A `#library` section, bg-white, inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24, holding one CTA card = relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 px-8 py-14 shadow-soft dotgrid sm:px-14, with a soft emerald glow blob (pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-16 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-emerald-200/40 blur-3xl). Centered content (relative mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an `h2` text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'Start from the dialog, not the blank canvas', a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-500 support line, and a mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 CTA pair: a primary 'Browse 200+ prompts' (rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700, ph:cards-bold) and a secondary 'Copy this dialog' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:bg-ink-50, ph:copy-bold). Footer: a `<footer>` border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-white with an inner mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-10: the small square logo lockup ('ModalDesign'), a text-sm text-ink-400 tagline 'A prompt-library pattern for overlays and dialogs.', and a flex gap-5 row of three text-ink-400 social icon links (ph:github-logo-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:book-open-bold).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A centered confirmation modal = a relative w-full max-w-md card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-dialog ring-1 ring-ink-900/5. Top edge: a full-width h-1 emerald accent bar = bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-emerald-500 to-emerald-600. Close affordance: an absolute right-4 top-5 grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-400 hover:bg-ink-100 hover:text-ink-700 button holding a ph:x-bold icon (width 14), aria-label 'Close dialog'. Body (px-7 pb-7 pt-9 text-center, sm:px-9 sm:pb-9): a centered status icon = mx-auto grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 with the .ring-emerald-soft glow, holding a text-emerald-600 ph:check-circle-bold icon (width 34); then an `h3` mt-6 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-900 question 'Publish this design?'; then a mx-auto mt-2.5 max-w-xs text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-500 consequence paragraph; then the action pair = a mt-7 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row (so the primary stacks ON TOP on mobile): a quiet Cancel = w-full rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50, and a filled primary = w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700 with a ph:rocket-launch-bold icon (width 16) 'Yes, publish'; then a mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-ink-400 reassurance line with a ph:lock-simple-bold icon (width 13) 'Visible to your workspace only'.

### Componente
The modal scrim that makes the dialog read as 'over a page': a `.backdrop-dim` layer (absolute inset-0 z-10) whose background layers a soft emerald top glow over a dark translucent fill: background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, rgba(16,185,129,0.10), transparent 55%), rgba(2,6,23,0.62); with backdrop-filter: blur(3px) and -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px). It sits above the faux dashboard placeholder page (z-0) and below the dialog (z-20), pushing the page back and parking attention on the single decision.

### Componente
An imperfect hand-drawn underline under the emerald headline phrase: an inline `<svg class='absolute -bottom-1.5 left-0 w-full' viewBox='0 0 300 12' preserveAspectRatio='none'>` containing a single `<path d='M2 9C60 3 240 3 298 7' stroke='#10b981' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.55'/>`. It sits inside a relative span so it tracks the width of the highlighted words ('don't make people flinch'), reading as a marker stroke rather than a flat border.

### Componente
A reusable feature tile = group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-soft transition hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-dialog. Top: a flex items-center gap-3 row with a 40x40 (h-10 w-10) grid place-items-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 icon tile (a Phosphor bold icon, width 20) beside a text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-400 step number ('01'..'05'). Then a mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-ink-900 title and a mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-500 description. On hover the whole tile lifts its border to emerald-300 and swaps shadow-soft -> shadow-dialog.

### Componente
A compact dialog preview used in the dark Variants band = rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white p-6 shadow-dialog. It holds a centered 48x48 (h-12 w-12) grid place-items-center rounded-xl tinted icon tile (the tint encodes intent: emerald-50/emerald-600, amber-50/amber-500, or rose-50/rose-500), a mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold text-ink-900 title, a mx-auto mt-1.5 max-w-[15rem] text-center text-sm text-ink-500 line, and a mt-5 flex gap-2.5 two-button row: a w-full rounded-lg border border-ink-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-600 quiet cancel, and a w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white filled action whose bg is the intent accent (emerald-600 / amber-500 / rose-600). Same skeleton, three tones, the tone living entirely in the icon, the accent fill and the verb.

## Notas Especiais
Stack: Tailwind via CDN (cdn.tailwindcss.com) with a custom inline theme: fontFamily.sans = ['Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif]; a slate-tinted 'ink' color ramp (50 #f8fafc -> 950 #020617) and an 'emerald' ramp (50 #ecfdf5 -> 900 #064e3b); two custom boxShadows: 'dialog' = 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(2,6,23,0.45), 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(2,6,23,0.30) and 'soft' = 0 1px 2px rgba(2,6,23,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(2,6,23,0.12). Google Fonts: Inter (400/500/600/700/800/900). Icons: Phosphor via Iconify (code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js), icons used: ph:squares-four-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:cards-bold, ph:cursor-click-bold, ph:check-circle-bold, ph:x-bold, ph:rocket-launch-bold, ph:lock-simple-bold, ph:circle-half-tilt-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:x-circle-bold, ph:magic-wand-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:warning-bold, ph:trash-bold, ph:copy-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:book-open-bold. Custom CSS: html { scroll-behavior: smooth }; body font-family Inter + -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; .dotgrid (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,23,42,0.06) 1px, transparent 0) sized 22px 22px); .backdrop-dim (radial emerald glow rgba(16,185,129,0.10) over rgba(2,6,23,0.62) + backdrop-filter blur(3px)); .text-balance (text-wrap: balance); .ring-emerald-soft (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.18)). Key techniques to preserve: (1) the dialog is rendered LIVE over a real dimmed/blurred faux dashboard page (3 stacked layers: placeholder page z-0, .backdrop-dim scrim z-10, dialog z-20) so it reads as a true overlay, not a flat card; (2) the dialog's action pair is flex flex-col-reverse on mobile and sm:flex-row on desktop, so the primary 'Yes, publish' sits ON TOP on small screens while the cancel stays left on desktop, and the dialog keeps a visible close X + a lock reassurance line so users are never trapped; (3) emerald is rationed to accents (logo glyph, hand-drawn underline, eyebrow pills, dialog top bar + check + primary buttons, anatomy hover borders, library CTA) over otherwise white/slate surfaces; (4) one deep .shadow-dialog drop-shadow is reserved for the floating modal (and card hover); everything else uses the lighter .shadow-soft; (5) the SAME dialog skeleton is shown three ways in the dark Variants band (emerald confirm / amber warning / rose danger), the tone living only in the icon, the accent fill and the verb; (6) text-wrap: balance on the big headlines and a hand-drawn SVG marker underline under the emerald phrase give the otherwise tidy page its warmth. Built/rendered responsive at 1440/768/390 and reproduced 1:1 via the superdesign CLI.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, full-bleed responsive marketing page; most sections center their content in an inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 lg:px-8 container, while the hero copy and section intros use a narrower max-w-2xl/3xl. Stacked top to bottom: a sticky translucent nav (h-16) -> a dot-grid hero (eyebrow pill + balanced headline with an emerald underlined phrase + sub + 2 CTAs) -> the showcase section (a faux dashboard page behind a dimmed/blurred scrim with the live confirmation dialog centered, min-height 640px) -> a white 'Anatomy' section (centered intro + a responsive 1/2/3-col grid of five numbered feature tiles + one emerald 'restyle in one prompt' CTA tile) -> a near-black (ink-950) 'Variants' band (centered intro + a 1/3-col grid of three mini-dialog cards: emerald confirm, amber warning, rose danger) -> a white 'Library' section holding one emerald-accented dot-grid CTA card (rounded-3xl) -> a footer. Sections are separated by hairline ink-200/70 borders; the page reflows from 3-col grids to single column and the dialog button pair flips to a stacked flex-col-reverse on mobile (so the primary action sits on top).

prompts.prompt: A `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white/85 backdrop-blur supports-[backdrop-filter]:bg-white/70">` with an inner `mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-6 lg:px-8`. Left: a logo lockup = a 36x36 (h-9 w-9) rounded-xl bg-ink-900 tile with shadow-soft holding an emerald-400 ph:squares-four-bold icon (width 20), next to a wordmark 'Modal' (text-[17px] font-extrabold tracking-tight) where 'Design' is text-emerald-600. Center (hidden md:flex, gap-9): four nav links 'Showcase / Anatomy / Variants / Library' in text-sm font-medium text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900. Right (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Sign in' text link (hidden sm:block, text-sm font-medium text-ink-600) and a primary CTA = inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700, reading 'Open in canvas' + a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon (width 14).

A `relative overflow-hidden border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white dotgrid` section with a thin top accent line (a pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-emerald-400/60 to-transparent). Inner: `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-14 pt-16 lg:px-8 lg:pb-20 lg:pt-24`, content centered in a max-w-3xl. Top: an eyebrow pill = inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-700 with a ph:cards-bold icon (width 14), reading 'Prompt library . Overlays & dialogs'. Headline: an `h1` mt-6 text-balance font-extrabold leading-[1.05] tracking-tight text-ink-900 scaling text-4xl -> sm:text-5xl -> lg:text-6xl, reading 'Confirmation dialogs that' then a relative text-emerald-600 (sm:whitespace-nowrap) span 'don't make people flinch' that has an absolute hand-drawn underline = an inline `<svg viewBox='0 0 300 12'>` path stroke #10b981 stroke-width 3 stroke-linecap round opacity 0.55 sitting -bottom-1.5 left-0 w-full. Subhead: a mx-auto mt-6 max-w-2xl text-balance text-lg leading-relaxed text-ink-500 paragraph. CTA row (mt-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 sm:flex-row): a primary ink button = inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-ink-900 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-ink-800 with a ph:cursor-click-bold icon (width 16) 'See the live dialog'; and a secondary outline button = rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-6 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 shadow-soft hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50 'Read the anatomy'. Both are w-full on mobile, sm:w-auto.

prompts.partPt: Showcase: dialog over a dimmed page
prompts.prompt: A `#showcase` section, relative isolate overflow-hidden bg-ink-50. Layer 1 (aria-hidden absolute inset-0 select-none): a faux app page = an inner mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-12 with a top bar (a flex justify-between row: an h-8 w-44 rounded-lg bg-ink-200/80 title placeholder, plus a flex gap-3 with an h-9 w-9 rounded-lg bg-ink-200/70 icon button and an h-9 w-24 rounded-lg bg-emerald-200/60 button), then a grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of six h-44 rounded-2xl border border-ink-200/70 bg-white shadow-soft placeholder cards. Layer 2: the `.backdrop-dim` scrim = absolute inset-0 z-10. Layer 3 (relative z-20): a flex min-h-[640px] w-full items-center justify-center px-5 py-20 sm:py-24 holding the centered confirmation dialog (a relative w-full max-w-md; see special components 'Confirmation dialog').

An `#anatomy` section, border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-white, inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24. Centered intro (mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an eyebrow 'Anatomy' (text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-600), an `h2` mt-3 text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'Five parts. No more, no less.', and a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-500 support line. Then a mt-14 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of five numbered feature tiles + one CTA tile. Each feature tile = group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-soft hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-dialog, with a top row of a 40x40 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 icon tile (Phosphor icons: ph:circle-half-tilt-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:squares-four-bold, ph:x-circle-bold) beside a tiny text-ink-400 number ('01'..'05'), then a mt-5 text-lg font-bold title and a mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-500 paragraph (titles: Dimmed backdrop / Status icon / Title & message / Action pair / Escape hatch). The sixth CTA tile = flex flex-col justify-between rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-50 to-white p-6 shadow-soft, with a 40x40 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white ph:magic-wand-bold tile, a 'Restyle in one prompt' title, a text-ink-600 paragraph, and a bottom emerald-700 'Browse the library ->' text link (ph:arrow-right-bold).

A `#variants` section, border-b border-ink-200/70 bg-ink-950 (near-black #020617), inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24. Centered intro (mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an emerald-400 eyebrow 'Variants', an `h2` mt-3 text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'One pattern, every intent', and a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-400 support line. Then a mt-14 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 of three mini-dialog cards, each = rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white p-6 shadow-dialog with a centered 48x48 rounded-xl tinted icon tile, a mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold title, a mt-1.5 centered text-sm text-ink-500 line, and a mt-5 flex gap-2.5 button pair (a quiet outline cancel + a filled accent action). Intent 1 = emerald: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 ph:check-circle-bold, 'Confirm' / 'Publish this design?' / Cancel + bg-emerald-600 'Publish'. Intent 2 = amber: bg-amber-50 text-amber-500 ph:warning-bold, 'Discard changes' / 'You have unsaved edits.' / 'Keep editing' + bg-amber-500 'Discard'. Intent 3 = rose: bg-rose-50 text-rose-500 ph:trash-bold, 'Delete project' / 'This can't be undone.' / Cancel + bg-rose-600 'Delete'.

prompts.partPt: Library Chamada Final para Ação + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: A `#library` section, bg-white, inner mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-20 lg:px-8 lg:py-24, holding one CTA card = relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-ink-200 bg-ink-50 px-8 py-14 shadow-soft dotgrid sm:px-14, with a soft emerald glow blob (pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 -top-16 h-56 w-56 rounded-full bg-emerald-200/40 blur-3xl). Centered content (relative mx-auto max-w-2xl text-center): an `h2` text-balance font-extrabold tracking-tight text-3xl sm:text-4xl 'Start from the dialog, not the blank canvas', a mt-4 text-lg text-ink-500 support line, and a mt-8 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 CTA pair: a primary 'Browse 200+ prompts' (rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700, ph:cards-bold) and a secondary 'Copy this dialog' (rounded-xl border border-ink-300 bg-white px-7 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:bg-ink-50, ph:copy-bold). Footer: a `<footer>` border-t border-ink-200/70 bg-white with an inner mx-auto flex max-w-7xl flex-col lg:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 px-6 py-10: the small square logo lockup ('ModalDesign'), a text-sm text-ink-400 tagline 'A prompt-library pattern for overlays and dialogs.', and a flex gap-5 row of three text-ink-400 social icon links (ph:github-logo-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:book-open-bold).

special_ui_components.prompt: A centered confirmation modal = a relative w-full max-w-md card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white shadow-dialog ring-1 ring-ink-900/5. Top edge: a full-width h-1 emerald accent bar = bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 via-emerald-500 to-emerald-600. Close affordance: an absolute right-4 top-5 grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg text-ink-400 hover:bg-ink-100 hover:text-ink-700 button holding a ph:x-bold icon (width 14), aria-label 'Close dialog'. Body (px-7 pb-7 pt-9 text-center, sm:px-9 sm:pb-9): a centered status icon = mx-auto grid h-16 w-16 place-items-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 with the .ring-emerald-soft glow, holding a text-emerald-600 ph:check-circle-bold icon (width 34); then an `h3` mt-6 text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-ink-900 question 'Publish this design?'; then a mx-auto mt-2.5 max-w-xs text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink-500 consequence paragraph; then the action pair = a mt-7 flex flex-col-reverse gap-3 sm:flex-row (so the primary stacks ON TOP on mobile): a quiet Cancel = w-full rounded-xl border border-ink-200 bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-700 hover:border-ink-300 hover:bg-ink-50, and a filled primary = w-full inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-soft hover:bg-emerald-700 with a ph:rocket-launch-bold icon (width 16) 'Yes, publish'; then a mt-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-ink-400 reassurance line with a ph:lock-simple-bold icon (width 13) 'Visible to your workspace only'.

The modal scrim that makes the dialog read as 'over a page': a `.backdrop-dim` layer (absolute inset-0 z-10) whose background layers a soft emerald top glow over a dark translucent fill: background: radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 0%, rgba(16,185,129,0.10), transparent 55%), rgba(2,6,23,0.62); with backdrop-filter: blur(3px) and -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(3px). It sits above the faux dashboard placeholder page (z-0) and below the dialog (z-20), pushing the page back and parking attention on the single decision.

An imperfect hand-drawn underline under the emerald headline phrase: an inline `<svg class='absolute -bottom-1.5 left-0 w-full' viewBox='0 0 300 12' preserveAspectRatio='none'>` containing a single `<path d='M2 9C60 3 240 3 298 7' stroke='#10b981' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.55'/>`. It sits inside a relative span so it tracks the width of the highlighted words ('don't make people flinch'), reading as a marker stroke rather than a flat border.

A reusable feature tile = group rounded-2xl border border-ink-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-soft transition hover:border-emerald-300 hover:shadow-dialog. Top: a flex items-center gap-3 row with a 40x40 (h-10 w-10) grid place-items-center rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 icon tile (a Phosphor bold icon, width 20) beside a text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-400 step number ('01'..'05'). Then a mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-ink-900 title and a mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-500 description. On hover the whole tile lifts its border to emerald-300 and swaps shadow-soft -> shadow-dialog.

A compact dialog preview used in the dark Variants band = rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-white p-6 shadow-dialog. It holds a centered 48x48 (h-12 w-12) grid place-items-center rounded-xl tinted icon tile (the tint encodes intent: emerald-50/emerald-600, amber-50/amber-500, or rose-50/rose-500), a mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold text-ink-900 title, a mx-auto mt-1.5 max-w-[15rem] text-center text-sm text-ink-500 line, and a mt-5 flex gap-2.5 two-button row: a w-full rounded-lg border border-ink-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-ink-600 quiet cancel, and a w-full rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white filled action whose bg is the intent accent (emerald-600 / amber-500 / rose-600). Same skeleton, three tones, the tone living entirely in the icon, the accent fill and the verb.

structured.special_notes: Stack: Tailwind via CDN (cdn.tailwindcss.com) with a custom inline theme: fontFamily.sans = ['Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif]; a slate-tinted 'ink' color ramp (50 #f8fafc -> 950 #020617) and an 'emerald' ramp (50 #ecfdf5 -> 900 #064e3b); two custom boxShadows: 'dialog' = 0 40px 80px -20px rgba(2,6,23,0.45), 0 12px 28px -8px rgba(2,6,23,0.30) and 'soft' = 0 1px 2px rgba(2,6,23,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(2,6,23,0.12). Google Fonts: Inter (400/500/600/700/800/900). Icons: Phosphor via Iconify (code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js), icons used: ph:squares-four-bold, ph:arrow-up-right-bold, ph:cards-bold, ph:cursor-click-bold, ph:check-circle-bold, ph:x-bold, ph:rocket-launch-bold, ph:lock-simple-bold, ph:circle-half-tilt-bold, ph:seal-check-bold, ph:text-aa-bold, ph:x-circle-bold, ph:magic-wand-bold, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:warning-bold, ph:trash-bold, ph:copy-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:x-logo-bold, ph:book-open-bold. Custom CSS: html { scroll-behavior: smooth }; body font-family Inter + -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; .dotgrid (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(15,23,42,0.06) 1px, transparent 0) sized 22px 22px); .backdrop-dim (radial emerald glow rgba(16,185,129,0.10) over rgba(2,6,23,0.62) + backdrop-filter blur(3px)); .text-balance (text-wrap: balance); .ring-emerald-soft (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(16,185,129,0.18)). Key techniques to preserve: (1) the dialog is rendered LIVE over a real dimmed/blurred faux dashboard page (3 stacked layers: placeholder page z-0, .backdrop-dim scrim z-10, dialog z-20) so it reads as a true overlay, not a flat card; (2) the dialog's action pair is flex flex-col-reverse on mobile and sm:flex-row on desktop, so the primary 'Yes, publish' sits ON TOP on small screens while the cancel stays left on desktop, and the dialog keeps a visible close X + a lock reassurance line so users are never trapped; (3) emerald is rationed to accents (logo glyph, hand-drawn underline, eyebrow pills, dialog top bar + check + primary buttons, anatomy hover borders, library CTA) over otherwise white/slate surfaces; (4) one deep .shadow-dialog drop-shadow is reserved for the floating modal (and card hover); everything else uses the lighter .shadow-soft; (5) the SAME dialog skeleton is shown three ways in the dark Variants band (emerald confirm / amber warning / rose danger), the tone living only in the icon, the accent fill and the verb; (6) text-wrap: balance on the big headlines and a hand-drawn SVG marker underline under the emerald phrase give the otherwise tidy page its warmth. Built/rendered responsive at 1440/768/390 and reproduced 1:1 via the superdesign CLI.
